definitions.explanation: A design or mechanism that allows something to be moved, adjusted, or repositioned.

examples.japanese: {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{可動式|かどうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}れる→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: This bridge is movable, allowing large ships to pass.

examples.japanese: {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{間仕切|まじき}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧レイアウト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えられる→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: You can freely change the room layout with movable partitions.

notes:
Combines ⟦{可動|かどう}→可動：20058_kadou⟧ (movable) with {式|しき} (type; style; model). Used as a noun modifier to describe things designed to be moved, adjusted, or reconfigured. Common in architecture, furniture, engineering, and product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: adjustable shelves
- {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧: movable bridge
- {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: movable wall
- {可動式|かどうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧: movable seats
- {可動式|かどうしき}⟦フィギュア→フィギュア：07081_figyua⟧: posable figure/action figure

THE SUFFIX {式|しき}:
The suffix {式|しき} indicates a type, style, or method:
- {固定式|こていしき}: fixed type
- {折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}: folding type
- {自動式|じどうしき}: automatic type
- {手動式|しゅどうしき}: manual type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {固定式|こていしき}: fixed type — the opposite; cannot be moved or adjusted
- {移動式|いどうしき}: portable; mobile — emphasizes the ability to relocate the entire unit, not just adjust parts
